tests.title: Works with the basic examples
tests.fail_why: Falla alguno de los ejemplos del enunciado.
tests.fail_how: Push al ver una apertura. Al ver un cierre: el tope debe ser su apertura correspondiente; si no, false.
tests.fail_why_en: One of the statement's examples fails.
tests.fail_how_en: Push when you see an opening bracket. On a closing bracket: the top must be its matching opening; if not, false.

tests.title: Handles empty strings and unmatched brackets
tests.fail_why: Falla con vacío, cierres sin apertura o aperturas sin cerrar.
tests.fail_how: Antes de hacer pop revisa stack.isEmpty() (si no, NoSuchElementException). Al final devuelve stack.isEmpty(), no true.
tests.fail_why_en: Fails with empty input, closings without an opening, or openings left unclosed.
tests.fail_how_en: Before popping check stack.isEmpty() (otherwise NoSuchElementException). At the end return stack.isEmpty(), not true.

tests.title: Works with deeply nested mixed brackets
tests.fail_how: El orden manda: ([)] es inválido aunque haya la misma cantidad de cada tipo.
tests.fail_how_en: Order rules: ([)] is invalid even though there are as many of each type.

tests.title: O(n): works with 1,000,000 characters in reasonable time
tests.fail_why: Tu solución no es lineal (por ejemplo reemplazar pares con replace en un ciclo, que es O(n²)).
tests.fail_how: Una pila y un solo recorrido: O(n).
tests.fail_why_en: Your solution is not linear (for example replacing pairs with replace in a loop, which is O(n²)).
tests.fail_how_en: One stack and a single pass: O(n).

tests.title: Uses Deque/ArrayDeque instead of the legacy Stack class
tests.fail_why: Usaste la clase Stack, que es legada y sincronizada (más lenta).
tests.fail_how: ArrayDeque como pila: push/pop/peek. En entrevista dilo: 'Deque es la recomendación de la documentación de Java'.
tests.fail_why_en: You used the Stack class, which is legacy and synchronized (slower).
tests.fail_how_en: ArrayDeque as a stack: push/pop/peek. In an interview say it: 'Deque is the recommendation in the Java documentation'.
